summary: QM (yc-software/qm) is a headless multiplayer agent core for Slack and web: a Node 24 TypeScript server (`node src/index.ts`, run directly without build) exposing an HTTP API whose `POST /v1/turns` runs one agent turn. The in-process Pi harness (HARNESS=pi, @earendil-works/pi-ai + pi-coding-agent) calls the model with the Anthropic SDK against `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (SDK appends /v1/messages); PI_MODEL picks a catalog id such as claude-opus-5. Agent tools (execute/read/write) always run inside a Sandbox backend; the default "local" backend drives a Docker CLI named by LOCAL_SANDBOX_DOCKER_BIN and talks HTTP to the repo's exec daemon aws/microvm-agent/agent.mjs. There is no one-shot CLI (cli/bin/qm.ts is a deployment control-plane tool), so the run boots the core with in-memory stores and ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_CORE=1, posts one turn with curl, prints the reply, and exits.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:jammy
FROM ${BASE}
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git jq xz-utils util-linux procps && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ARG NODE_VERSION=24.18.0
RUN set -eux; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64) a=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch" && exit 1 ;; esac; mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bin; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${a}.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src && CI=true npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && CI=true npm run build:connector-sdk && rm -rf /root/.npm /tmp/node-compile-cache
RUN echo '' | base64 -d > /opt/harness/bin/qm-docker && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/qm-docker && node --check /opt/harness/bin/qm-docker
ENV HARNESS=pi SANDBOX_BACKEND=local LOCAL_SANDBOX_DOCKER_BIN=/opt/harness/bin/qm-docker LOCAL_SANDBOX_IMAGE=qm-sandbox-shim
RUN mkdir -p /out /work
run_command:
set -euo pipefail
export QM_SHIM_WORKDIR="$PWD" QM_SHIM_STATE=/tmp/qm-sandbox-shim
mkdir -p /out "${DATA_DIR:-/out/qm-data}" /root
if [ -L /root/workspace ]; then rm -f /root/workspace; elif [ -d /root/workspace ]; then rmdir /root/workspace; fi
ln -s "$PWD" /root/workspace
node /opt/harness/src/src/index.ts > /out/qm-core.log 2>&1 &
CORE_PID=$!
trap 'kill $CORE_PID 2>/dev/null; pkill -KILL -f microvm-agent/agent.mjs 2>/dev/null; true' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-48080}/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; kill -0 $CORE_PID 2>/dev/null || { cat /out/qm-core.log; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done
jq -n --arg text "$TASK" '{surface:"cli",actor:{externalId:"operator"},conversation:{kind:"dm",threadRef:"task-1"},text:$text}' > /out/qm-turn-request.json
curl -s -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-48080}/v1/turns" -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @/out/qm-turn-request.json > /out/qm-turn-result.json
jq -r '.reply // .reason // .' /out/qm-turn-result.json
jq -e '.status == "ok"' /out/qm-turn-result.json >/dev/null
check_command: node /opt/harness/src/cli/bin/qm.ts --help >/dev/null && /opt/harness/bin/qm-docker version && test -f /opt/harness/src/.generated/connector-sdk/sdk.cjs && test -d /opt/harness/src/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && echo qm-install-ok
notes: Unchanged from the recipe for 861af65. Between 861af65 and a61db71 the root package.json, package-lock.json, .node-version, src/index.ts, the local sandbox backend, aws/microvm-agent and cli/bin did not change. The model catalog still has claude-opus-5, which is also the default. The config changes add only optional env vars (SECURITY_SCREEN_ALL_POSTURES, CAPABILITY_TOKEN_COMPRESSION), both off by default. The /v1/turns changes are additive: a new triggered model/harness check and clientTools, neither used here. Carried over from before: QM has no single-task CLI, so the run boots the core (node src/index.ts) with in-memory stores and posts one dm turn to POST /v1/turns. /opt/harness/bin/qm-docker is a small stand-in for the Docker CLI, set through LOCAL_SANDBOX_DOCKER_BIN. It starts the repo's exec daemon aws/microvm-agent/agent.mjs with cwd set to the task directory, and /root/workspace is symlinked to $PWD. Outputs go under /out: qm-core.log, qm-turn-request.json, qm-turn-result.json and qm-data/. Destructive commands pause for human approval, which a non-interactive run cannot grant, so those turns end as pending_approval or refused.
